hints: Identify the reflection in the $x$-axis from $-f(x)$.
walkthrough:
Describe the two successive transformations that map $y = f(x)$ to $y = 3 - f(x) = -f(x) + 3$ in order:
1. Reflection in the $x$-axis (or a vertical stretch of scale factor $-1$ parallel to the $y$-axis).
2. Followed by a translation by vector $\begin{pmatrix}0\\3\end{pmatrix}$ (or $3$ units upwards in the positive $y$-direction).
